narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The hole will be the same notch shape and nothing more, so I will draw only one notch.
<bookmark mark='open'/>Open the sheet slowly. The other layer was cut as well, so a second notch appears.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>One cut through two layers cannot make only one notch.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says the hole is only the notch; the sheet is half opened and a second notch shows on the other half; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Every cut on a folded sheet appears again across the fold as a mirror image.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Cut a half circle from the folded edge, with its straight side on the fold. What shape is the hole when you open it?
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows: a cut on the fold is repeated across the fold as a mirror image; then Your turn: a half circle cut with its straight side on the fold
